need: Keep the edit guard's per-decision log where it survives a worktree's removal and cannot be committed by accident, while one command still counts a repository's would-block decisions.

searched.where: src/lockstep/hook.py:172-187 and src/lockstep/init_repo.py:144-149 at d7f2eabfc; issue #974; read 2026-11-20
searched.query: where the guard logs today and what keeps that log out of git
searched.found: The guard writes <checkout>/.lockstep/hook-<date>.jsonl; only `lockstep init` adds `.lockstep/` to .gitignore. No environment override exists. The issue lists two fixes: log outside the checkout, or add the folder to .git/info/exclude.

searched.where: Team-Brains deploy/organizational-brains brain pull-request runner and its test test_hook_refusals_reach_the_record_and_the_pull_request, read 2026-11-19
searched.found: The runner mounts the checkout's .lockstep/ as ignored and reads refusals from it; it pins LOCKSTEP_SHA, so it keeps the old location until the pin moves.

searched.where: XDG Base Directory Specification 0.8 (specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec), from memory of the published text, not re-opened 2026-11-20
searched.query: standard per-user place for state that should persist but is not configuration or cache
searched.found: $XDG_STATE_HOME, default ~/.local/state, is for state data that persists between restarts, such as logs and history.

searched.where: pre-commit (cache in ~/.cache/pre-commit) and git's own worktree layout (`gitdir:` file pointing to <main>/.git/worktrees/<name>), from known behavior, not re-opened 2026-11-20
searched.query: how tools that run inside many checkouts keep their data out of them, and how to find the main checkout from a worktree
searched.found: pre-commit keeps per-user data outside every checkout; a worktree's .git file names its main repository's .git directory, which gives the main checkout's name without running git.

candidates.name: Log under $XDG_STATE_HOME/lockstep/<repository name>/ with a LOCKSTEP_LOG_DIR override
candidates.covers: Survives worktree removal; never inside a checkout, so never committed; the override keeps the Team-Brains runner's mounted folder working.
candidates.misses: Two repositories with the same folder name share a folder; each record's project field separates them.
candidates.reason: Fixes both effects in #974 with the standard location and no new dependency.

candidates.name: Add .lockstep/ to .git/info/exclude on first write
candidates.misses: Logs written in a worktree are still deleted with it, so guard use stays uncountable, which is what both proofs need.
candidates.reason: Leaves the undercount, the effect the proofs depend on.
